rows.grounds: compound adjective: kārya (effect) + bhāva (state) + samāpannā (attained), describing the goddess
compound adjective: prakṛti (primordial matter) + rūpiṇī (having-form/nature), describing the goddess

items.question: What nature does the supreme goddess assume in the condition of effect?
premises: The goddess attains the condition of effect.
In that attained condition she remains constant.
Her constant nature in that condition is prakṛti.
items.inference: When manifest as effect, the goddess always abides in the nature of prakṛti.
uncertainties: Whether prakṛti here refers specifically to Sāṃkhya primordial matter or a more general material nature is not fully explicit in this verse alone.
items.plain_english: Having attained the state of effect, she is always of the nature of primordial matter.
